item.title: ♿️ [Polity/Rights issues] Colour-coded card system for PHYSICALLY HANDICAPPED (PH) certificate » Mrunal
item.description: The Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DePWD) has updated the process for obtaining disability certificates. Applicants must now apply through the UDID portal and may wait up to three months for their cards. Medical checkups must be from government or recognized private hospitals. White, yellow, and blue cards will be issued based on the degree of disability.
